name: @argszero/cordis-plugin-client-bundle-conflict-guard
description: Client bundle conflict guard for dsh: the Web host concatenates the client bundles of every mounted plugin into one classic script per combo batch, with no per-bundle scope, so two bundles that declare the same name at their top level silently overwrite each other ('var'/'function') or make the whole script a SyntaxError ('let'/'const'/'class'). Mounted on the composed boot graph (ClientModuleRegistry.graph()/clientPath()), this plugin scans every bundle's top-level declarations, cross-checks them across the bundles that share a script, and names the colliding packages and identifiers in the host log — a failure that otherwise surfaces only as an unattributed browser SyntaxError. Source: discussion #7290. Compatible with the dsh 0.1.2, 0.1.3, 0.1.5 and 0.1.6 prerelease lines.
